pkgmetadata.longdescription:
Lumo is Proton's AI assistant, offered with a Proton account. The desktop app adds a tray icon, a global shortcut, scheduled tasks and connectors (local filesystem, shell, Proton Mail Bridge, MCP servers).
It is a Tauri app on top of the system WebKitGTK. This package installs the upstream prebuilt .deb; credentials are kept in the desktop keyring through the Secret Service API.
